Container.Name: risk-seven
Container.Overview: Risk Seven table. First to 200. Do not add another port. Use only the Port setting below: put the same free number in host and container. Leave the WebUI URL at the top unchanged. A second copy is a second container with a different name and port.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: The only port you set. Put the same free number in Host Port and Container Port. Do not add another port. Do not edit the WebUI URL at the top of the form.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Public https origin if you use a reverse proxy, e.g. https://riskseven.example.com
